name: Defrost LSWUSDC reentrancy
summary: The Defrost LSWUSDC vault released the underlying USDC before updating the caller's share accounting, so re-entering the withdrawal from the token callback let one deposit be redeemed repeatedly until the vault's USDC was gone.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
